description: This file is a JavaScript module that defines underscore templating functions, initializes Google Analytics, and includes functions for fetching files and issues, as well as a Learn class for rendering content related to TodoMVC examples.

classes.name: Learn
classes.description: A class for managing and rendering the learn section of the TodoMVC example, including fetching issue counts and appending content.

methods.name: Learn.prototype.append
methods.description: Renders the learn content into the DOM, customizing links based on backend or local demo.

methods.name: Learn.prototype.fetchIssueCount
methods.description: Fetches the number of open issues from GitHub and updates the DOM accordingly.
